evidence.quote: PURPOSE:To provide a photographic film cartridge where the inadvertent rotation of a spool is prevented.
PURPOSE:To inexpensively provide a camera and a photographic film cartridge which can be accurately positioned in the cartridge loading chamber of the camera.

PURPOSE:To smoothly shift a usual zooming operation to an ultra-variable power operation by using a zooming operation part used for the usual zooming operation such as a seesaw knob also as an operation part for switching to ultra-variable power.
